hello-guild:
👋 Hello there!

I'm your friendly AI-powered moderation bot.
I help keep this server safe and respectful by detecting and managing hate speech, toxic behavior and harmful content in real time.

✅ Respect others
🚫 No hate speech or harassment
🤖 I'm always learning to improve moderation

Let's build a positive community together!
ban: Guild user %s has been banned due to exceed the limit number of guild's anti hate speech warnings.
warning: 🚩: Guild user %s has just gotten their (%s/%s) hate speech warning.
limit-change-success: Guild limit value of warnings per user changed from %s to %s
limit-change-error-1: Error: The new limit value isn't a number
limit-change-error-2: Error: The new limit value cannot be less than zero
limit-change-error-3: Error: the new limit value of warnings allowed in Guild cannot be the same as the current one (%s)
forgive-error-2: Error: user isn't at Guild database
forgive-error-3: Error: user hasn't any warnings and isn't banned at current Guild
forgive-success: User "%s" has been forgiven in this Guild
